headlines.text: Flash back to 2019, when the AEW Women's World Title made its debut as Riho vs. Nyla Rose battled for the honor of being first champion, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.77. A true David-versus-Goliath contest to crown AEW's first-ever Women's World Champion ? Rose's power advantage looked overwhelming for long stretches, but Riho kept kicking out and won the crowd over completely before pulling off the underdog victory.

Rewind to 2024, when Will Ospreay vs. Ricochet fought tooth and nail for the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.46 ? a match that delivered. Ricochet was challenging for gold for the very first time. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

2024 brought us this moment: Bryan Danielson vs. Kazuchika Okada went to battle over the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.83 ? a match that delivered. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2019, when it was the first-ever encounter between Ortiz & Santana & Jericho and The Elite, serving as the night's main event on Dynamite, rated 6.24.
It was 2019 when PAC vs. Adam Page crossed paths for the first time ever on Dynamite, rated 6.81.
2024 brought us this moment: it marked the first-ever meeting between Adam Page and Juice Robinson on Dynamite, rated 6.60.
